claims.claim: Hurricane Polo is a category three storm with maximum sustained winds near 115 mph and is forecast to make landfall on Mexico's Baja California Sur later Monday or early Tuesday.
claims.episode_span: The category three storm, with maximum sustained winds near 115 mph (185 km/h), is expected to move over Baja California Sur
claims.source_title: Mexico's Pacific coast braces for Hurricane Polo
claims.supporting_quote: The category three storm, with maximum sustained winds near 115 mph (185 km/h), is expected to move over the state Baja California Sur, a region popular with tourists and home to the resort destination of Los Cabos.

claims.claim: The U.S. National Hurricane Center warned of life-threatening flooding, mudslides and storm surge from Hurricane Polo.
claims.episode_span: The U.S. National Hurricane Center warned of heavy rain that could cause life-threatening flooding and mudslides
claims.source_title: Mexico's Pacific coast braces for Hurricane Polo
claims.supporting_quote: Meteorologists at the US-based National Hurricane Center (NHC) have warned of heavy rainfall which could lead to life-threatening flooding and mudslides, especially in areas of steep terrain.

claims.claim: Baja California Sur ordered schools closed Monday, the governor said shelters had opened, and federal authorities deployed thousands of navy and army personnel.
claims.episode_span: The state government ordered schools closed on Monday; Governor Víctor Manuel Castro Cosío said temporary shelters had been opened
claims.source_title: Mexico's Pacific coast braces for Hurricane Polo
claims.supporting_quote: The regional government of Baja California Sur has ordered schools to remain closed on Monday as a preventive measure.

claims.claim: Thailand's government said eight people died in flooding since September 16, none in Bangkok, with deaths in Sa Kaeo, Chanthaburi and Saraburi.
claims.episode_span: eight people have died in flooding since September 16 — five in Sa Kaeo, two in Chanthaburi and one in Saraburi — and none of them in Bangkok
claims.source_title: Eight dead in Thailand floods since mid-September
claims.supporting_quote: The eight died in eastern provinces - five in Sa Kaeo, two in Chanthaburi and one in Saraburi - according to the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation (DDPM), which did not give further details.

claims.claim: Not including Bangkok, more than 500,000 households and 1.7 million people across 27 provinces were affected, plus 52,000 households in Bangkok.
claims.episode_span: more than 500,000 households and 1.7 million people across 27 provinces have been affected, with a further 52,000 households hit in Bangkok
claims.source_title: Eight dead in Thailand floods since mid-September
claims.supporting_quote: Not including Bangkok, more than 500,000 households and 1.7 million people across 27 provinces in the Southeast Asian country have been affected by flooding, the DDPM said.

claims.claim: After two U.S. citizens were killed in an ICE operation in Minneapolis, Donald Trump said in February a softer touch might be wiser, and Markwayne Mullin said he wanted the department off the daily lead story.
claims.episode_span: President Donald Trump said in February that he had learned a softer touch might be wiser
claims.source_title: Gone in 90 seconds: an ‘invisibilized’ ICE is arresting more people than ever
claims.supporting_quote: “I learned that maybe we could use a little bit of a softer touch,” Donald Trump said in February.

claims.claim: An ICE agent shot Wilber Rafael Garcés Pérez in Austin; he left hospital with a bullet near his spine and was taken to detention.
claims.episode_span: an ICE agent shot Wilber Rafael Garcés Pérez in Austin
claims.source_title: Gone in 90 seconds: an ‘invisibilized’ ICE is arresting more people than ever
claims.supporting_quote: Last week, an ICE agent shot Wilber Rafael Garcés Pérez in Austin, Texas.

claims.claim: The European Commission is planning accession road maps for Ukraine, Montenegro, Moldova and Albania, and not for other candidates at this stage.
claims.episode_span: the European Commission is drawing up proposals for step-by-step membership paths for Ukraine, Montenegro, Moldova and Albania
claims.source_title: The EU is preparing "road maps" for accession for Ukraine and three other countries
claims.supporting_quote: The European Commission is planning clear schedules for reforms and negotiations for Ukraine, Montenegro, Moldova and Albania. They will not be offered to other candidates for now.

claims.claim: India's Supreme Court on September 28 took suo motu cognisance of alleged sexual assaults in Delhi-NCR and sought a response from Delhi Police.
claims.episode_span: the Supreme Court on Monday took up on its own a series of alleged sexual assaults against minors and women in Delhi-NCR
claims.source_title: Supreme Court takes suo motu cognisance of recent sexual assault cases in Delhi-NCR, flags ‘lax patrolling’ by authorities
claims.supporting_quote: The Supreme Court on Monday (September 28, 2026) took suo motu cognisance of a spate of sexual assault incidents against minors and women in Delhi-NCR, seeking a response from the Delhi Police and observing that public spaces, including parks, buses and Metro stations, cannot be allowed to become “zones of high risk” because of “lax patrolling and other preventable administrative deficiencies”.

claims.claim: Officials say Russian bombardment in Ukraine killed at least three civilians and wounded 41 others.
claims.episode_span: officials say Russian bombardment killed at least three civilians and wounded 41 others
claims.source_title: Russian drones target civilian areas as Ukraine claims battlefield breakthroughs
claims.supporting_quote: Russia’s round-the-clock bombardment in Ukraine killed at least three civilians and wounded 41 others, officials say

claims.claim: French maritime police said three people including a child died and dozens were injured from a dinghy carrying 105 people off northern France.
claims.episode_span: maritime police said three people, including a child, died and dozens were hurt on a dinghy carrying 105
claims.source_title: Three people dead, including a child, in attempt to cross Channel to UK
claims.supporting_quote: A child was among three people who died ⁠and dozens of others who were injured while ⁠attempting ​to cross the Channel on Monday, French authorities have said.

claims.claim: France's National Rally and allies won a record 14 Senate seats, effectively quadrupling their number in the 348-seat chamber.
claims.episode_span: National Rally and allies took a record 14 Senate seats, four times their previous total in the 348-seat chamber
claims.source_title: Le Pen hails 'victory' as French far right secures record 14 seats in Senate
claims.supporting_quote: France's far-right National Rally (RN) party and its allies emerged from polls with a record 14 seats in the right-wing dominated Senate on Sunday, effectively quadrupling its number in the 348-seat chamber just months before a presidential election.

claims.claim: Aliko Dangote said a refinery in Lamu, Kenya, with planned capacity of 700,000 barrels per day, is expected to begin construction on September 30.
claims.episode_span: Aliko Dangote said construction of a 700,000-barrel-a-day refinery in Kenya’s Lamu is expected to start September 30
claims.source_title: Kenyan President Ruto Calls Dangote Refinery an Engineering Masterpiece
claims.supporting_quote: Dangote Petroleum Refinery expects to begin construction of an oil refinery in the coastal city of Lamu on September 30. The facility’s planned capacity will be 700,000 barrels per day.

claims.claim: Geovany Andres Rojas, who faces U.S. drug-trafficking and terrorism charges, was flown from Colombia to California.
claims.episode_span: authorities flew Geovany Andres Rojas, who faces U.S. drug-trafficking and terrorism charges, to California
claims.source_title: Accused drug lord known as "The Spider" extradited to California from Colombia
claims.supporting_quote: Geovany Andres Rojas faces drug trafficking and terrorism charges in the United States.

claims.claim: Canadian tariffs on several hundred U.S. products took effect on September 8 after talks were suspended on August 21, and each side's measures cover about $20 billion.
claims.episode_span: Canadian tariffs on several hundred American products took effect on September 8, after talks on a new trade agreement were suspended on August 21
claims.source_title: The six fronts in the US-Canada trade war
claims.supporting_quote: On September 8, Canadian tariffs on several hundred U.S. products went into effect, marking the culmination of weeks of tension between the two neighbors.

claims.claim: Bangladesh Bank allowed international-card ticket purchases covering 17 foreign airlines even when settlement is abroad, and those purchases will not count toward travel entitlement.
claims.episode_span: lets residents buy tickets on 17 foreign airlines with international cards even when those airlines settle payments abroad
claims.source_title: Bangladesh Bank widens international card use for buying airline tickets
claims.supporting_quote: The facility will cover 17 foreign airlines operating in Bangladesh.
